newsitem.title: CENTRAL AFRICAN REPUBLIC: Bangui death toll 58, Red Cross says.
newsitem.headline: Bangui death toll 58, Red Cross says.

text.p: The death toll in clashes between African peacekeepers and disaffected soldiers in the Central African Republic capital Bangui was at least 58 and could be as high as 104, the local Red Cross said on Tuesday.

Doctor David Dofara, head of the organisation, said that the figure of 58 was based on a Red Cross body count while the figure of 104 was based on reports from various witnesses whose stories tallied.

The clashes began on Friday after an incident between peacekeepers and a group of armed soldiers who had not yet rejoined their units under a January 25 peace deal brokered by Mali's former military leader Amadou Toumani Toure after three army revolts in under a year.
